records.title: Scaling Behavior of Discrete Diffusion Language Models
records.reason: The work studies training scaling laws across noise types and hyperparameters for DLMs, comparing data/compute scaling to autoregressive models. It is linked to diffusion serving but chiefly concerns pretraining efficiency, not decode-time serving or KV-cache design.

records.title: ClawsBench: Evaluating Capability and Safety of LLM Productivity Agents in Simulated Workspaces
records.reason: ClawsBench is a simulated-workspace capability and safety benchmark; it analyzes model/scaffold/harness effects, not inference optimization. The link to unified-memory desktop inference supplies only deployment context.

records.title: TurboDiffusion: Accelerating Video Diffusion Models by 100-200 Times
records.reason: Video diffusion generation acceleration, not language-model inference.

records.title: ExploitGym: Can AI Agents Turn Security Vulnerabilities into Real Attacks?
records.reason: Security-agent attack benchmark, not LLM serving or inference efficiency.

records.title: Streaming Video Question-Answering with In-context Video KV-Cache Retrieval
records.reason: The system retrieves cached video-context representations for streaming VideoQA and reports improved efficiency against VideoQA baselines. It is a modality-specific KV retrieval method; evidence does not establish applicability to text-only LLM KV caches.
